decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Drawing Numbers  4D056351R, P100A, P101, P102, P103, P104, P105, P106, P107, P108, P100, Noise Impact Assessment Report, Eternal Building Fabric Specification, Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment received 22/04/13) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority
description: Erection of two air condensor units to the roof, reduction in height of existing flood defence, replacement of existing windows at first and second floor level, alteration to line of the steps at ground floor level and replacement of existing balconies at ground and first floor level
